keyword: why silver has industrial demand driving price
angle: Industrial applications now consume the majority of global silver supply, and a fifth straight structural deficit is putting sustained pressure on prices.

stats.claim: Industrial applications account for roughly 59% of total global silver demand in 2025.
Global silver market on course for fifth consecutive structural deficit in 2025, estimated at approximately 95 million ounces.
Cumulative silver market deficits from 2021 through 2025 total nearly 820 million ounces.
Photovoltaic silver demand reached about 186.6 million ounces in 2025 before expected 19% decline in 2026 to roughly 151 Moz.
Battery-electric vehicles use an estimated 25-50 grams of silver per vehicle, roughly 67-79% more than an ICE car.
Total silver industrial fabrication forecast at around 650 million ounces in 2026.
